    Morita equivalence for a full idempotent #

    Mathlib's current Morita API does not yet contain the full-idempotent criterion. This file supplies the needed construction for a finite dimensional algebra. Since Mathlib's TensorProduct is over a commutative base, the relative tensor product is constructed as the quotient of the ordinary k-tensor product by the balancing relations.

    source
    structure LargeIndecomposable.FullnessCertificate {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] (e : R) :
    Type u_1

    A finite expression witnessing that e generates the unit two-sided ideal.

    • terms : List (R × R)
    • sum_mul : (List.map (fun (p : R × R) => p.1 * (e * p.2)) self.terms).sum = 1
